readme_risk_summary_zh: 原生摘录轨道2400字符：Book完整证据70/72（97.2%）、固定策略消费46/48（95.8%）；完整证据不是80题的70题。
共享整块轨道2400字符：Book70/72与46/48，billion-context64/72与40/48；逐题Book8胜2负，优势集中在历史决策题，两个中文split_policy题落后。
共享整块轨道1200字符：Book58/72与34/48，billion-context64/72与40/48，逐题8胜14负；不能宣称所有预算下都优于对方。
原生摘录轨道相较基线的两个新增成功均为training历史问题；两个中文split_policy旧失败现在变成stale-only，两个预算均由0升至2。
这两个中文问题的固定消费者原先因无策略而弃答，现在分别选到过时row_modulo/whole_group，正确值应为whole_group/chronological；虽然完整证据和策略成功的布尔值仍为失败，错误形态确实恶化。
原生摘录轨道和共享整块轨道的打包规则不同；禁止把原生摘录Book1200结果与共享整块billion结果拼成公平对照。
8个标记为无证据的问题中，检索后端均返回非空上下文；本实验没有验证可靠拒答或生成答案的事实性。
这是80个合成开发诊断问题，包含成对项目和固定策略消费者；没有LLM生成、真实开发者任务或生产环境成本评估。
计时来自同机观测，运行时进程边界、输出组装和缓存不同；仅能按原报告解释，不是受控性能提升或完整产品速度比较。

track_boundaries.workflow: Native Book/flat excerpts versus fixed recent-project-history/no-memory baselines; adaptive segmentation, top 5, no result cache.
track_boundaries.components: Same full source-page bodies, project filter, top 5, native candidate order, shared whole-block packer; oversized blocks skipped. Native excerpts ignored.
track_boundaries.component_feature_limit: Book retains hierarchy/FTS features; billion receives uniform assistant message title/body/project. Same source text does not mean equivalent indexed features or whole products.
track_boundaries.timing_limit: Book native timer includes in-process Python context assembly. Billion has separate searchBlocks and persistent-JSON roundtrip times. Common pack reads an in-memory supplied fixture and excludes real decompression/follow-up reads. Processes restart at each checkpoint; results are reused across both budgets.
